status.QUEUED: On this till, not sent yet
status.DUPLICATE: Sent and recorded (already on the server)
status.REJECTED_INTEGRITY: Refused: the record changed after printing

storeError.title: This browser cannot keep sales on the device
storeError.body: The till keeps every sale on this device before it sends it, and this browser refused the storage. Use the till's own browser profile, not a private window, and make sure the device has space.

noDevice.title: This till is not set up
noDevice.body: Choose which register this device is before selling.
noDevice.askManager: Ask a manager to set this device up as a till.

noShift.title: No shift is open
noShift.body: Open a shift on {{register}} with its float to start selling.

otherCashier.title: This till's open shift is {{name}}'s
otherCashier.body: One person sells on a shift. {{name}} closes it, or a manager signs its close off from the Shift page.

noPack.title: The till's prices have not downloaded
noPack.body: The till sells from the price list it downloads for the shift. Download it now.
noPack.offline: The till sells from the price list it downloads for the shift, and it has none. Connect the till to download it.

NO_PACK.title: The till has no prices
NO_PACK.body: Connect the till and download them.

PACK_EXPIRED.title: The till's prices are out of date
PACK_EXPIRED.body: No new sale can be made from them. Connect the till so it downloads today's prices.

OFFLINE_TOO_LONG.title: The till has been offline too long to sell
OFFLINE_TOO_LONG.body: A till may sell for a limited time without reaching the server. Connect it: the sales on it will be sent, and selling starts again.

QUEUE_FULL.title: The till holds as many unsent sales as it may
QUEUE_FULL.body: Connect the till so its sales are sent. No new sale can be added until then.

notice.noPrice: {{name}} has no price on this till
notice.noUnits: No {{name}} is sellable at this till
notice.quoteOnly: {{name}} is sold by quote only, not at the till
notice.unsellableBody: The till's list says it is sold, on hold or at another location. Check the animal or lot before selling it.

find.title: Find an item
find.search: Search by name, SKU or tag
find.searchHint: An animal or a lot by its tag, for example G-0142.

cart.title: This sale
cart.emptyBody: Tap an item or search for one to start the sale.
cart.fixLines: An item needs its weight before payment.

line.title: Change {{name}}
line.oneAnimal: {{name}} is one animal: its quantity is 1.
line.weightHint: The last recorded weight is filled in as an estimate. Weigh the animal to replace it.
line.weightHintPerKg: The price is per kilogram: weigh the item.
line.priceHint: The list price unless you agreed another inside the band.

errors.quantity: Enter a quantity, such as 3 or 2.5.
errors.reason: Choose why the price differs from the list price.

refusal.BELOW_FLOOR: That price is below the lowest the band allows
refusal.ABOVE_CEILING: That price is above the highest the band allows
refusal.OVER_LINE_LIMIT: That discount is more than you may give on one item
refusal.OVER_SHIFT_LIMIT: That discount takes your shift past what you may give

line.refusalBody: You may give up to {{line}} off an item and {{shift}} on a shift. A manager can agree more in the back office.
line.supervisorBody: A discount of {{discount}} on this item is more than you may give. A supervisor of the branch may approve it with their PIN on this till. The price is reported to the server with who approved it.
line.noSupervisor: No supervisor on this till may approve a discount of {{discount}}: change the price to within your limit.
line.approvedBy: Approved by {{name}}’s PIN: a discount of {{discount}} on this item.
line.overSupervisorLimit: {{name}} may approve up to {{limit}} off an item.

choose.unitBody: Each is sold by its tag. Choose the one the customer is taking.

unpriced.MISSING_GRADE_OR_WEIGHT: No price: it needs a grade or a weight first
unpriced.NO_RULE: No price: no price list prices it
unpriced.QUOTE_ONLY: Sold by quote only, not at the till

pay.title: Take payment
pay.body: Take the other tenders first; cash pays the rest and the till works out the change.
pay.confirmBody: Check every amount with the customer. The sale is kept on this till the moment you complete it.
pay.noCash: This till offers no cash tender. It cannot take payment.
pay.offlineCashOnly: The till is offline: cash only until it reconnects.
pay.handedHint: What the customer gives you, before change.
pay.short: The cash handed over is short by
pay.tooMuch: The other tenders come to more than the sale. Change is given in cash only.
pay.saving: Keeping the sale on this till
pay.sendsNow: It is sent to the server at once; the official receipt number follows.
pay.queuedOffline: The till is offline: the sale waits on this till and is sent when it reconnects.
pay.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +233244512876. The farm sends the receipt link to it by SMS once the sale reaches the server.
pay.phoneError: A phone number starts with + and the country code.
pay.buyer: A business buyer on the receipt
pay.buyerHint: Optional. For a business that needs its name and TIN on the receipt. It makes no customer account.
pay.buyerTinHint: A GRA TIN such as C0000000042, or a Ghana Card PIN such as GHA-123456789-0.

buyerProblem.NAME_WITHOUT_TIN: Enter the business’s TIN too, or clear the name.
buyerProblem.TIN_WITHOUT_NAME: Enter the business name too, or clear the TIN.
buyerProblem.NAME_INVALID: Keep the name to 160 characters, on one line.
buyerProblem.TIN_INVALID: This is not a GRA TIN or a Ghana Card PIN.

pay.buyerConfirm: On the receipt as the buyer: {{name}}, TIN {{tin}}.

momo.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +233244512876.
momo.pendingBody: Ask the customer to approve the payment on {{phone}}, then check it.
momo.failedBody: The provider says the payment failed. Nothing was taken by mobile money.
momo.refused: The mobile money payment did not go through

done.title: Sale complete
done.queued: Kept on this till as {{ref}}; the official number follows when it is sent.
done.exceptions: The server recorded the sale and raised these for a manager

receipt.label: Receipt {{ref}}
receipt.officialFollows: Follows when the sale is recorded
receipt.copyMarker: COPY: reprint of a receipt already given, not a new sale
receipt.printCopy: COPY: reprint, not a new sale

held.holdBody: It is kept on the register: any till of it can bring it back.
held.holdOffline: The till is offline: the sale is kept on this till only.
held.label: Name it (optional)
held.done: The sale is held. Its prices are checked again when it comes back.
held.recallBody: Its prices are checked again against the till's list.
held.recalled: The held sale is back, at today's prices.
held.recallFailed: The held sale did not come back
held.offlineList: Held sales on the register show once the till reconnects.
held.registerUnreachable: Held sales on the register could not be read.

pin.label: PIN
pin.wrong_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} more wrong try locks {{name}}’s PIN on every till.
pin.wrong_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} more wrong tries lock {{name}}’s PIN on every till.
pin.lockedOut: {{name}}’s PIN is locked after too many wrong tries, on every till. It does not end with time: only when {{name}} sets a new PIN, signed in on a till while it is online.
pin.noVerifier: This till holds no PIN for {{name}}. {{name}} sets one with “Set my till PIN”, signed in on this till while it is online.
pin.weakVerifier: The server sent a PIN check for {{name}} that is weaker than this till accepts, so the till will not store or check it. {{name}} can set a new PIN with “Set my till PIN” while this till is online.
pin.noneHere: No one who can approve this has a PIN on this till. A supervisor sets one, signed in on a till while it is online, and this till reads it the next time it reaches the server.
pin.refused: The server sent PIN checks this till refuses as weaker than it accepts: {{names}}. They cannot use a PIN on this till until they set a new one with “Set my till PIN”.

set.title: Set my till PIN
set.body: Your PIN opens this till when it is locked, and a supervisor’s PIN approves and witnesses on it, with or without the network. Your till makes a check from it and sends only that: the PIN itself never leaves this till.
set.replaces: A new PIN replaces your last one on every till, and ends a lockout. Tills read it the next time they reach the server.
set.mismatch: The two PINs are not the same. Type it again.
set.done: Your till PIN is set. It works on this till now.
set.failed: Your till PIN was not set.
set.offline: Setting a PIN needs the server. Connect the till.

unverified.title: Mobile money without the network
unverified.body: The till cannot check this payment. A supervisor approves it with their PIN, the receipt says it is not yet verified, and it is matched to the provider's statement later.
unverified.reference: Transaction id the customer shows (if any)
unverified.add: Take it as not yet verified
unverified.unavailable: Mobile money without the network needs a supervisor's PIN on this till, which it does not hold. Take cash.
